title: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
text: Landmark constitutional law decision establishing the basic structure doctrine. The case considered Parliament's power to amend the Constitution, judicial review, fundamental rights, property rights, and limits on constitutional amendments.

title: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India
text: Expanded Article 21 due process and personal liberty protections. The dispute concerned passport impoundment, natural justice, fair procedure, reasonableness, and the relationship between Articles 14, 19, and 21.

title: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan
text: Created workplace sexual harassment guidelines before statutory legislation. The case addressed gender equality, safe working conditions, fundamental rights, international conventions, employer duties, complaints committees, and prevention of sexual harassment.

title: Justice K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India
text: Nine-judge bench decision recognizing privacy as a fundamental right. The judgment discusses dignity, autonomy, informational privacy, data protection, surveillance, proportionality, and constitutional protections under Articles 14, 19, and 21.

title: S.R. Bommai v. Union of India
text: Constitutional federalism case limiting arbitrary use of President's Rule. The judgment addressed Article 356, secularism, floor tests, democratic governance, judicial review, and Centre-State relations.

title: Mohd. Ahmed Khan v. Shah Bano Begum
text: Family law and maintenance decision under criminal procedure. The case involved maintenance rights of a divorced Muslim woman, social justice, personal law, Section 125 CrPC, and support obligations.

title: Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia v. State of Punjab
text: Leading anticipatory bail precedent. The judgment explains discretion under Section 438 CrPC, arrest protection, personal liberty, conditions for bail, accusations of corruption, and limits on blanket restrictions.

title: P. Chidambaram v. Directorate of Enforcement
text: Economic offence bail and custodial interrogation decision. The case concerned money laundering investigation, financial irregularities, anticipatory bail, gravity of economic offences, flight risk, and investigative needs.

title: Fateh Chand v. Balkishan Das
text: Contract law decision on liquidated damages and penalty clauses. The dispute considered breach of contract, earnest money, compensation, forfeiture, Section 74 of the Contract Act, and proof of reasonable damages.

title: Kailash Nath Associates v. Delhi Development Authority
text: Modern contract damages case on forfeiture and liquidated damages. The judgment considered public auction breach, earnest money, Section 74, compensation without proved loss, and when forfeiture is legally sustainable.

title: Cadila Health Care Ltd. v. Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
text: Trademark and passing off decision for medicinal products. The Court discussed deceptive similarity, consumer confusion, pharmaceutical marks, public health risk, packaging, pronunciation, and tests for infringement.

title: Parle Products Pvt. Ltd. v. J.P. and Co.
text: Trademark infringement and deceptive packaging precedent. The case involved similar wrappers, biscuits, visual similarity, ordinary purchaser confusion, passing off, and comparison of competing trade dress.

title: Goa Foundation v. Union of India
text: Environmental mining case involving illegal iron ore mining in Goa. The decision addressed environmental clearance, sustainable development, intergenerational equity, mining leases, ecological damage, and regulatory compliance.

title: Lafarge Umiam Mining Pvt. Ltd. v. Union of India
text: Forest and environmental clearance decision for limestone mining. The judgment discussed environmental impact assessment, forest diversion, public interest, sustainable development, expert appraisal, and project clearance conditions.

title: MSR Leathers v. S. Palaniappan
text: Negotiable Instruments Act decision on cheque dishonour. The case addressed Section 138, statutory notice, legally enforceable debt, repeated presentation of cheques, limitation, and criminal liability for cheque bounce.

title: Dashrath Rupsingh Rathod v. State of Maharashtra
text: Cheque bounce jurisdiction decision under Section 138. The judgment considered dishonour of cheque, place of drawee bank, criminal complaint jurisdiction, statutory notice, and prosecution of negotiable instrument offences.

title: Workmen of Firestone Tyre and Rubber Co. v. Management
text: Labour law precedent on dismissal and domestic enquiry. The case addressed wrongful termination, industrial discipline, misconduct, natural justice, tribunal powers, reinstatement, back wages, and employer procedure.

title: Secretary, State of Karnataka v. Umadevi
text: Public employment decision on regularisation of temporary workers. The judgment discussed constitutional equality, illegal appointments, backdoor entry, state employment, labour claims, and limits on regularisation.

title: Gaurav Nagpal v. Sumedha Nagpal
text: Child custody decision emphasizing welfare of the minor. The case addressed guardianship, parental rights, visitation, custody disputes, best interests of children, family court considerations, and child welfare.

title: Pune Municipal Corporation v. Harakchand Misirimal Solanki
text: Land acquisition compensation decision under the 2013 Act. The dispute involved lapse of acquisition proceedings, possession, compensation deposit, statutory interpretation, landowners, and acquisition benefits.

title: Model Tenancy Act, 2021
text: Rental housing reference covering landlord and tenant rights, written tenancy agreements, rent revision, security deposit, maintenance duties, eviction process, rent authority, and disputes about sudden rent increases or house occupancy.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
text: Consumer law reference covering consumer complaints, defective goods, deficiency in service, unfair trade practices, misleading advertisements, product liability, e-commerce transactions, district consumer commissions, and remedies for buyers.

title: IRDAI Policyholder Protection Regulations
text: Insurance law reference covering proposal forms, material information, medical disclosure, policyholder protection, insurer duties, claim processing, free look period, grievance redressal, and consequences of non-disclosure in insurance contracts.

title: Copyright Act, 1957
text: Intellectual property reference covering copyright in photographs and artistic works, permission to use images, infringement, ownership, publication, licensing, fair dealing, remedies, and unauthorized use of creative material.

title: Indian Contract Act, 1872
text: Contract law reference covering valid agreement, offer, acceptance, consideration, free consent, lawful object, capacity of parties, void agreements, breach of contract, compensation, liquidated damages, and enforceability of business arrangements.

title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 - Stalking and Harassment Reference
text: Criminal law reference covering repeated unwanted contact, stalking, following or contacting a person despite disinterest, harassment, threatening conduct, mental distress, personal liberty, privacy, and criminal intimidation. Useful for situations involving repeated unwanted phone calls, messages, threats, blackmail, abusive words, or cyber harassment.

title: Information Technology Act, 2000 - Cyber Harassment Reference
text: Cyber law reference covering electronic communication, online harassment, obscene electronic content, threatening messages, misuse of digital communication, privacy concerns, and cyber complaint context. Useful for repeated unwanted calls, messages, social media abuse, blackmail, or digital intimidation.
